definition: P1 and P2 modal-response vectors are fused before localization because a structural mode shape is independent of input location

modal_vector_fusion.input_location_weighting: equal after phase alignment and unit-norm normalization
modal_vector_fusion.healthy_references: four fused references from two recordings and two sweep directions
modal_vector_fusion.damage_estimates: two fused estimates from the upward and downward sweep passages

healthy_only_graph_hyperparameters.selection_rule: twofold held-out healthy negative log likelihood

comparator_definition: endpoint_node_energy uses raw endpoint magnitude; normalized_endpoint_node_energy normalizes every modal residual field before endpoint averaging; direct_node_coordinate smooths the normalized node field directly at sensor coordinates without forming candidate-edge scores
